description: Bicycle Parking is a dataset listed in City of Richmond open data portal (www.transparentrichmond.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Richmond. Planned and existing bicycle parking including multiple styles of racks as well as electronic bicycle lockers. Coverage: Richmond, Virginia. The portal files it under the category Engineering & Capital Improvement Projects. Its tags are bicycle, parking, bike rack, bike locker, bike. The table has 20 columns. Attribution on the portal: Engineering & CIP. The portal shows 2019-09-24 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-transparentrichmond-org-portal.
